changeSet.author: vasileios.vitzilaios@keyes.eu
changeSet.comment: METS-2566: Remove 0 yearly emissions from rpt_reportable_emissions for NOT_REQUIRED AERs where there is no DRE
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM rpt_reportable_emissions rre WHERE COALESCE(rre.is_from_dre, false) = false AND rre.emissions = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r WHERE r.type = 'AER' AND r.status = 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND r.account_id = rre.account_id AND CAST(r.metadata->>'year' AS INTEGER) = rre.year );

changeSet.author: vasileios.vitzilaios@keyes.eu
changeSet.comment: METS-2566: Remove emissions field from request metadata for NOT_REQUIRED AERs so they show as null instead of 0
changeSet.sql: UPDATE request SET metadata = metadata - 'emissions' WHERE type = 'AER' AND status = 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND (metadata->>'emissions')::NUMERIC = 0;
